title: Explicit open direct-image and base-change source comparisons
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories of O-modules [def-pc-derived-category] and derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For an open V⊆S, put U=f⁻¹V, f₀=f|V, and let R_S and R_X be restriction to V and U [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Define singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso(f,V):Rf_*⋙R_S≅R_X⋙Rf₀_* by deriving the sectionwise identity f_*M|V=f₀_*(M|U), using exact restriction and preservation of K-injectives. Explicitly compose the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso, rightDerivedFunctorNatIso of the underived sectionwise identity, rightDerivedFunctorCompIso for restriction followed by f₀_*, and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory whiskered by Rf₀_*. For g:S′→S, K∈D(O_X), opens V⊆S and V′⊆S′ with V′⊆g⁻¹V, define singleComplexOpenBaseChangeSourceIso(f,g,K,V,V′):R_{S′}(Lg*Rf_*K)≅L(g|V′)*Rf₀_*(R_XK). Its factors are inverse open pullback on S′ [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], composition along V′.ι and g [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], the equality g|V′≫V.ι=V′.ι≫g, inverse composition along g|V′ and V.ι, L(g|V′)* of open pullback on S, and L(g|V′)* of singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso(f,V). These are real constructed data, with no arbitrary existence witness.

def singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) :
    schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ (schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ V)
